  <li><strong>Legislative Agenda:</strong> The Union government has approved amendments to the anti-paper leak law and introduced a bill in the Rajya Sabha proposing a three-year jail term for insulting the Vande Mataram.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary Deadlock:</strong> The INDIA bloc continues to pressure the NDA government over NEET irregularities, leading to repeated adjournments and accusations from the BJP that the opposition is avoiding constructive debate.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court Ruling:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed the Centre and CBSE to include an opt-out provision in the APAAR consent form and prohibited the unauthorized sharing or monetization of court proceedings.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Failed Legislation:</strong> A Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at implementing women’s reservation in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the Lok Sabha.</li>
</ul>
